items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Anna Mae Winburn was singing with us, at the time.

ctx.x: Gus, you people would have died if you'd been stuck a week in the snow.
That's right, sure, sure. This guy, he came and got us. Anna Mae Winburn was singing with us, at the time.
Well, that's a story, isn't it? Did anybody do anything for that guy?
